<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover" />
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0a0a0a" />
<title>Optiline — Leadership Dashboard</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Michroma&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#0a0a0a;--panel:#141414;--panel-2:#1b1b1b;--line:#2a2a2a;
    --red:#E1251B;--red-soft:rgba(225,37,27,.16);--red-glow:rgba(225,37,27,.4);
    --white:#fff;--grey-4:#808080;--muted:#8b8b8b;
    --green:#3ec46d;--amber:#f2711c;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  body{
    min-height:100vh;
    background:
      radial-gradient(1200px 700px at 85% -10%, rgba(225,37,27,.10), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(700px 500px at 100% -5%, rgba(225,37,27,.10), transparent 60%),
      var(--bg);
    background-attachment:fixed;
    color:var(--white);font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
  }
  body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.05;z-index:0;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 46%, #fff 46%, #fff 49%, transparent 49%),
      linear-gradient(225deg, transparent 46%, #fff 46%, #fff 49%, transparent 49%);
    background-size:120px 120px;background-position:60px 0}
  .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:1560px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(14px,1.6vw,28px) clamp(14px,2vw,40px) 40px}
  header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:clamp(14px,1.4vw,22px)}
  .brandblock{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}
  .logo{height:clamp(26px,2vw,40px);width:auto;align-self:flex-start;flex:none;object-fit:contain;display:block;margin-bottom:7px}
  .titles{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1}
  .kicker{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.4em;font-size:clamp(9px,.72vw,12px);color:var(--red);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:7px}
  h1{font-family:'Michroma';font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,36px);letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase}
  .clock{text-align:right;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;align-items:flex-end}
  .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;font-size:clamp(9px,.7vw,11px);color:#fff;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--red-soft);border:1px solid var(--red);border-radius:99px;padding:4px 12px}
  .live .pulse{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--red);animation:pulse 1.8s infinite}
  .time{font-family:'Michroma';font-size:clamp(15px,1.4vw,24px)}
  .asof{font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(9px,.72vw,12px);color:var(--grey-4);letter-spacing:.06em}
  .kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:clamp(8px,.9vw,14px);margin-bottom:clamp(12px,1.2vw,20px)}
  .kpi{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel),var(--panel-2));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:clamp(11px,1vw,18px) clamp(12px,1.1vw,20px);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
  .kpi::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;background:var(--red)}
  .kpi .klabel{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(9px,.66vw,11px);color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
  .kpi .klabel .c{color:var(--red)}
  .kpi .kval{font-family:'Michroma';font-size:clamp(18px,1.7vw,30px);line-height:1.05;margin:7px 0 3px}
  .kpi .kval.t-red{color:#ff5f53} .kpi .kval.t-green{color:var(--green)} .kpi .kval.t-amber{color:var(--amber)}
  .kpi .ksub{font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(9px,.72vw,12px);color:var(--grey-4)}
  .kpi .ksub b{font-weight:700}
  .up{color:var(--green)} .down{color:var(--red)} .flat{color:var(--amber)}
  .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:clamp(10px,1vw,16px)}
  .panel{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel),#0f0f0f);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:clamp(13px,1.1vw,20px);min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
  .col-12{grid-column:span 12}.col-8{grid-column:span 8}.col-6{grid-column:span 6}.col-7{grid-column:span 7}.col-5{grid-column:span 5}.col-4{grid-column:span 4}.col-3{grid-column:span 3}
  .ptop{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
  .ptitle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,17px)}
  .ptitle .c{color:var(--red)}
  .pmeta{font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(9px,.74vw,12px);color:var(--grey-4);letter-spacing:.04em;text-align:right}
  .prow{margin-bottom:11px}
  .prow:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
  .prow .top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;margin-bottom:5px}
  .prow .name{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(11px,.86vw,14px)}
  .prow .nums{font-family:'Michroma';font-size:clamp(10px,.8vw,13px)}
  .prow .nums .t{color:var(--grey-4);font-size:.85em}
  .prow .pct{color:var(--red);font-family:'Michroma';font-size:.85em;margin-left:7px}
  .bar{height:11px;background:#0c0c0c;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
  .bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff4d3d,var(--red));box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--red-glow);transition:width 1.2s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
  .bar i.g{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#34d97f,#22a85f);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(62,196,109,.35)}
  .bar i.a{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff9a3c,#f2711c);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(242,113,28,.32)}
  .bar .tick{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.75);z-index:3}
  .ggrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}
  .mini{background:#0e0e0e;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;padding:11px 13px}
  .mini .l{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
  .mini .v{font-family:'Michroma';font-size:clamp(16px,1.4vw,24px);margin:5px 0 2px}
  .mini .s{font-size:10px;color:var(--grey-4)}
  .finrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:12px}
  .fincard{background:#0e0e0e;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;padding:11px 14px}
  .fincard .fl{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
  .fincard .fv{font-family:'Michroma';font-size:clamp(15px,1.3vw,22px);margin:5px 0 2px}
  .fincard .fx{font-size:10px;color:var(--grey-4)}
  .fintop{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:clamp(12px,1.4vw,24px);margin-top:16px}
  .topcol .th{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(10px,.8vw,12px);color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-bottom:9px}
  .topcol .th .c{color:var(--red)}
  .toprow{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}
  .toprow:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .toprow .rk{font-family:'Michroma';font-size:.78em;color:var(--red);min-width:1.4em}
  .toprow .nm{font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(11px,.84vw,13.5px);color:#d7d7d7;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;flex:1;min-width:0}
  .toprow .am{font-family:'Michroma';font-size:clamp(11px,.84vw,13.5px);white-space:nowrap}
  .bdgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:clamp(12px,1.2vw,20px)}
  .bdsub{background:#0e0e0e;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:13px 15px}
  .bdhead{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:13px;padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .bdt{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(11px,.84vw,13px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
  .bdt .c{color:var(--red)}
  .bdtot{font-family:'Michroma';font-size:clamp(12px,.92vw,15px);white-space:nowrap}
  .bdtot small{font-family:'Inter';color:var(--grey-4);font-weight:600;font-size:.7em;margin-left:5px}
  .entrow{padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:9px;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}
  .entrow .name{font-weight:800}
  .chart{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
  .legend{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:11px;color:var(--grey-4);margin-top:10px}
  .legend span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
  .legend i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block}
  .swA{background:var(--red)} .swB{background:#4a4a4a} .swT{background:#c98a2e}
  .wgrp{margin-bottom:14px}
  .wgrp:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
  .wghead{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .wghead .wr{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(11px,.82vw,13px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
  .wghead .wr .c{color:var(--red)}
  .wghead .wm{font-family:'Michroma';font-size:clamp(10px,.78vw,12px);color:var(--grey-4);white-space:nowrap}
  .wghead .wm b{color:#fff}
  .wjobs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
  .wjob{font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(10px,.78vw,12.5px);padding:5px 11px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0e0e0e;color:#d7d7d7}
  .stats{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
  .stat{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}
  .stat:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .stat .sl{font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(11px,.84vw,14px);color:#d7d7d7}
  .stat .sv{font-family:'Michroma';font-size:clamp(12px,.92vw,16px);white-space:nowrap}
  .stat .sv small{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:600;color:var(--grey-4);font-size:.7em;margin-left:6px}
  .pill{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:99px}
  .pill.g{color:var(--green);background:rgba(62,196,109,.13);border:1px solid rgba(62,196,109,.4)}
  .pill.a{color:var(--amber);background:rgba(242,113,28,.14);border:1px solid rgba(242,113,28,.45)}
  .pill.r{color:#ff6a5e;background:var(--red-soft);border:1px solid var(--red)}
  footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-top:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .vline{font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,16px);color:#dcdcdc;letter-spacing:.02em}
  .vline .tenx{font-family:'Michroma';color:var(--red);margin-left:9px;text-shadow:0 0 14px var(--red-glow)}
  .refresh{font-family:Inter;font-weight:700;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;background:var(--red-soft);border:1px solid var(--red);border-radius:99px;padding:4px 12px;cursor:pointer;margin-top:6px}
  .refresh:hover{background:var(--red)}
  .src{font-size:10px;color:#5a5a5a;letter-spacing:.04em}
  .hwwrap{overflow:auto;max-height:540px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px}
  .hwtable{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:clamp(10px,.8vw,13px);min-width:680px}
  .hwtable th,.hwtable td{padding:8px 13px;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap;border-bottom:1px solid #1c1c1c;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  .hwtable th{position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--panel-2);color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.86em;z-index:2}
  .hwtable td:first-child,.hwtable th:first-child{text-align:left;position:sticky;left:0;background:#141414;font-weight:600;color:#e6e6e6}
  .hwtable th:first-child{background:var(--panel-2);z-index:3}
  .hwtable tbody tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#101010}
  .hwtable tbody tr:hover td{background:#181818}
  .hwtable td{font-family:'Michroma';font-size:clamp(9px,.72vw,11.5px);color:#d7d7d7}
  .hwtable td:first-child{font-family:'Inter'}
  .hstrip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:clamp(8px,.9vw,13px);margin-bottom:14px}
  @media (max-width:900px){.hstrip{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
  .hstrip .mini .v .ar{font-size:.66em;margin-right:3px;vertical-align:middle}
  @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.25}}
  @media (max-width:1180px){
    .kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
    .col-8,.col-7,.col-6,.col-5,.col-4,.col-3{grid-column:span 12}
    .bdgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    .finrow{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
    .fintop{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  }
  @media (max-width:1400px){.fintop{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
  @media (max-width:620px){.kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bar i{transition:none!important}.live .pulse{animation:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
  <header>
    <div class="brandblock">
      <div class="titles">
        <img class="logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Optiline">
        <span class="kicker">Optiline Enterprises</span>
        <h1>Leadership Dashboard</h1>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="clock">
      <span class="live"><span class="pulse"></span> Live</span> <button id="refreshBtn" class="refresh">↻ Refresh</button>
      <span class="time" id="time">—</span>
      <span class="asof" id="asof">—</span>
    </div>
  </header>

  <section class="kpis" id="kpis"></section>

  <section class="grid">
    <div class="panel col-12">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Financial Health</div></div>
      <div class="finrow" id="finance"></div>
      <div class="fintop" id="finTop"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel col-8">
      <div class="ptop">
        <div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>2026 Billed Revenue — Actual vs Projection</div>
        <div class="pmeta" id="revMeta">—</div>
      </div>
      <div id="revChart"></div>
      <div class="legend"><span><i class="swA"></i> Actual</span><span><i class="swB"></i> Projection</span><span><i class="swT"></i> Target $11.25M/mo</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel col-4">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Current Projected Revenue Pace</div></div>
      <div id="annual"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel col-12">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Preconstruction — Pipeline · Awards · Bids by Region</div><div class="pmeta">2026 · vs path-to-$1B targets</div></div>
      <div class="bdgrid" id="bd"></div>
      <div class="legend" id="bdLegend" style="margin-top:12px"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel col-5">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Current Projected Revenue By Regions</div><div class="pmeta">vs full-year target</div></div>
      <div id="region"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel col-7">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Cost Discipline — YTD</div><div class="pmeta">% of revenue</div></div>
      <div class="ggrid" id="costGauges"></div>
      <div style="margin-top:16px" id="laborTrend"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel col-12">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Project Risk — Watch List</div><div class="pmeta" id="riskMeta">—</div></div>
      <div id="risk"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel col-8">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Workforce &amp; HR</div><div class="pmeta" id="hrMeta">—</div></div>
      <div class="ggrid" id="hrGauges" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)"></div>
      <div style="margin-top:16px" id="laborMix"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel col-4">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Field Staffing &amp; Safety</div></div>
      <div class="stats" id="staffing"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel col-12">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Hours Worked &mdash; Weekly</div><div class="pmeta" id="hoursMeta">&mdash;</div></div>
      <div class="hstrip" id="hoursStrip"></div>
      <div class="hwwrap"><table class="hwtable" id="hoursTable"></table></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <footer>
    <div class="vline">Creating Opportunity Through Growth.<span class="tenx">10X</span></div>
    <div class="src" id="src">Source: Optiline 2026 KPI workbook</div>
  </footer>
</div>

<script>
/*DATA_START*/
// Live data is injected by boot(D) from Apps Script getData().
var ASOF,MONTHS,REV_PROJ,REV_ACT,ACT_MONTHS,REV_TARGET_MONTHLY,ANNUAL,GROSS_PROFIT,NET_PROFIT,BD,REGIONS,COST,LABOR_MONTHLY,LABOR_TARGET,FIN,OVER90_TREND,WATCH,SAFETY,TRIR,HR,HOURS,HOURS_TREND;
/*DATA_END*/

const $=(id)=>document.getElementById(id);
const fmtM=v=>{ if(v==null) return "—"; const a=Math.abs(v);
  if(a>=1e9) return (v<0?"-":"")+"$"+(a/1e9).toFixed(2)+"B";
  if(a>=1e6) return (v<0?"-":"")+"$"+(a/1e6).toFixed(1)+"M";
  if(a>=1e3) return (v<0?"-":"")+"$"+(a/1e3).toFixed(0)+"K";
  return (v<0?"-":"")+"$"+Math.round(a); };
const pct=(n,d)=>d?Math.round(n/d*100):0;
const fmtNum=n=>n==null?'—':Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US');
function yearFrac(){var n=new Date(),s=new Date(n.getFullYear(),0,1),e=new Date(n.getFullYear()+1,0,1);return (n-s)/(e-s)*100;}
var YEAR_PCT=yearFrac();

function kpiTiles(){
  const ytdAct=REV_ACT.slice(0,ACT_MONTHS).reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0);
  const ytdTarget=REV_TARGET_MONTHLY*ACT_MONTHS;
  const tgtTone=p=>p>=100?'green':'red';
  const paceTone=p=>p>=100?'green':(p>=YEAR_PCT?'amber':'red');
  const selfPerform=(HR.field||0)+(HR.pms||0)+(HR.foremen||0);
  const totalHC=(HR.employees||0)+(HR.contractField||0);
  const tiles=[
    {l:"Billed Rev — YTD", v:fmtM(ytdAct), s:`${pct(ytdAct,ytdTarget)}% of ${fmtM(ytdTarget)} YTD target`, tone:tgtTone(pct(ytdAct,ytdTarget))},
    {l:"Rev Pace", v:pct(ANNUAL.projection,ANNUAL.target)+"%", s:`${fmtM(ANNUAL.projection)} of ${fmtM(ANNUAL.target)}`, tone:tgtTone(pct(ANNUAL.projection,ANNUAL.target))},
    {l:"OE Pipeline", v:fmtM(BD.pipeline.total), s:`${pct(BD.pipeline.total,BD.pipeline.target)}% of ${fmtM(BD.pipeline.target)} target`, tone:tgtTone(pct(BD.pipeline.total,BD.pipeline.target))},
    {l:"2026 Awards", v:fmtM(BD.awards.total), s:`${pct(BD.awards.total,BD.awards.target)}% of ${fmtM(BD.awards.target)} goal`, tone:paceTone(pct(BD.awards.total,BD.awards.target))},
    {l:"Labor / COGS — YTD", v:Math.round(COST.cogs*100)+"%", s:`<span class="${COST.cogs<=0.82?'up':'down'}">${COST.cogs<=0.82?'▼':'▲'} 82% target</span> · L ${Math.round(COST.labor*100)}% · M ${Math.round(COST.material*100)}%`, tone:(COST.cogs>0.82?'red':'green')},
    {l:"TRIR", v:(typeof TRIR!=="undefined"&&TRIR?TRIR.value.toFixed(2):"—"), s:(typeof TRIR!=="undefined"&&TRIR?`<span class="${TRIR.value<=TRIR.target?'up':'down'}">target ${TRIR.target.toFixed(1)}</span>`:""), tone:(typeof TRIR!=="undefined"&&TRIR?(TRIR.value>TRIR.target?'red':'green'):'')},
    {l:"Recordables — YTD", v:String(SAFETY.recordables), s:`${SAFETY.fatalities} fatalities · ${SAFETY.severe} severe`},
    {l:"Headcount", v:String(totalHC), s:`${HR.employees} W-2 · ${HR.contractField} sub · ${selfPerform} self-perform`},
    {l:"Active Projects", v:String(HR.activeProjects), s:`${HR.projectsWithForeman} with OE foreman`},
  ];
  $("kpis").innerHTML=tiles.map(t=>
    `<div class="kpi"><div class="klabel"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>${t.l}</div>
     <div class="kval ${t.tone?'t-'+t.tone:''}">${t.v}</div><div class="ksub">${t.s}</div></div>`).join("");
}

function revChart(){
  const W=820,H=300,padL=46,padR=12,padT=14,padB=34;
  const n=MONTHS.length, gw=(W-padL-padR)/n;
  const max=Math.max(...REV_PROJ,...REV_ACT.filter(v=>v!=null),REV_TARGET_MONTHLY)*1.08;
  const y=v=>padT+(H-padT-padB)*(1-v/max);
  let g="";
  for(let k=0;k<=4;k++){const gv=max*k/4; const yy=y(gv);
    g+=`<line x1="${padL}" y1="${yy}" x2="${W-padR}" y2="${yy}" stroke="#222" stroke-width="1"/>`;
    g+=`<text x="${padL-6}" y="${yy+4}" fill="#666" font-size="10" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter">$${(gv/1e6).toFixed(0)}M</text>`;}
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const x0=padL+i*gw, bw=gw*0.30, gap=gw*0.10;
    const proj=REV_PROJ[i], act=REV_ACT[i];
    const xp=x0+gw*0.5-bw-gap*0.5, xa=x0+gw*0.5+gap*0.5;
    g+=`<rect x="${xp}" y="${y(proj)}" width="${bw}" height="${H-padB-y(proj)}" rx="2" fill="#444"/>`;
    if(act!=null){ const hit=act>=proj;
      g+=`<rect x="${xa}" y="${y(act)}" width="${bw}" height="${H-padB-y(act)}" rx="2" fill="${hit?'#E1251B':'#b9302a'}"/>`; }
    g+=`<text x="${x0+gw*0.5}" y="${H-padB+15}" fill="#9a9a9a" font-size="10.5" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-weight="600">${MONTHS[i]}</text>`;
  }
  const yt=y(REV_TARGET_MONTHLY);
  g+=`<line x1="${padL}" y1="${yt}" x2="${W-padR}" y2="${yt}" stroke="#c98a2e" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>`;
  g+=`<text x="${W-padR}" y="${yt-5}" fill="#e0a64a" font-size="10" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-weight="700">Target $${(REV_TARGET_MONTHLY/1e6).toFixed(2)}M/mo</text>`;
  $("revChart").innerHTML=`<svg class="chart" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" role="img">${g}</svg>`;
  const ytdAct=REV_ACT.slice(0,ACT_MONTHS).reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0);
  const ytdTarget=REV_TARGET_MONTHLY*ACT_MONTHS;
  $("revMeta").innerHTML=`YTD actual <b style="color:#fff">${fmtM(ytdAct)}</b> · ${pct(ytdAct,ytdTarget)}% of ${fmtM(ytdTarget)} target`;
}

function prow(name,actual,target,fmt,pace,colorMode){
  const p=target?actual/target*100:0; const w=Math.max(2,Math.min(100,p));
  // colorMode 'target' = red until 100% then green; default = pace (red below year%, yellow ahead, green 100%+)
  const cls = (colorMode==='target') ? (p>=100?'g':'') : (p>=100?'g':(p>=YEAR_PCT?'a':''));
  const tick=pace?`<span class="tick" title="${Math.round(YEAR_PCT)}% of year" style="left:${YEAR_PCT}%"></span>`:'';
  return `<div class="prow"><div class="top"><span class="name">${name}</span>
    <span class="nums">${fmt(actual)} <span class="t">/ ${fmt(target)}</span><span class="pct">${Math.round(p)}%</span></span></div>
    <div class="bar"><i class="${cls}" data-w="${w}"></i>${tick}</div></div>`;
}

function annualPanel(){
  let h=prow("Projected Billed Revenue",ANNUAL.projection,ANNUAL.target,fmtM,false,'target');
  h+=prow("Projected Gross Profit",GROSS_PROFIT.current,GROSS_PROFIT.target,fmtM,false,'target');
  h+=prow("Projected Net Profit",NET_PROFIT.current,NET_PROFIT.target,fmtM,false,'target');
  h+=`<div class="legend" style="margin-top:13px"><span><i style="background:#E1251B"></i> Below target</span><span><i style="background:#3ec46d"></i> Target met</span></div>`;
  $("annual").innerHTML=h;
}

function bdPanel(){
  const blocks=[{b:BD.pipeline,pace:false},{b:BD.awards,pace:true,ent:true},{b:BD.bids,pace:true,ent:true}];
  $("bd").innerHTML=blocks.map(o=>{
    const b=o.b, p=pct(b.total,b.target);
    const entRow=o.ent?`<div class="entrow">`+prow("Enterprise (all regions)",b.total,b.target,fmtM,o.pace)+`</div>`:"";
    const rows=entRow+b.regions.map(r=>prow(r[0],r[1],r[2],fmtM,o.pace)).join("");
    return `<div class="bdsub">
      <div class="bdhead"><span class="bdt"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>${b.label}</span>
      <span class="bdtot">${fmtM(b.total)}<small>/ ${fmtM(b.target)} · ${p}%</small></span></div>
      ${rows}</div>`;
  }).join("");
  var bl=$("bdLegend");
  if(bl) bl.innerHTML=`Color vs ${Math.round(YEAR_PCT)}% of year —<span><i style="background:#E1251B"></i> behind</span><span><i style="background:#f2711c"></i> ahead</span><span><i style="background:#3ec46d"></i> met</span>`;
}

function regionPanel(){ $("region").innerHTML=REGIONS.map(r=>prow(r.name,r.actual,r.target,fmtM)).join(""); }

function costGauges(){
  const items=[
    {l:"COGS",v:COST.cogs,s:"of revenue"},
    {l:"Total Labor",v:COST.labor,s:"of revenue"},
    {l:"Materials",v:COST.material,s:"of revenue"},
  ];
  $("costGauges").innerHTML=items.map(i=>
    `<div class="mini"><div class="l">${i.l}</div><div class="v">${Math.round(i.v*100)}%</div><div class="s">${i.s}</div></div>`).join("");
}
function laborTrend(){
  const W=720,H=120,padL=36,padR=10,padT=10,padB=22, n=LABOR_MONTHLY.length;
  const gw=(W-padL-padR)/Math.max(n,6);
  const y=v=>padT+(H-padT-padB)*(1-(v-0.30)/(0.60-0.30));
  let g=`<text x="${padL-6}" y="${y(0.30)+4}" fill="#666" font-size="9" text-anchor="end">30%</text>`;
  g+=`<text x="${padL-6}" y="${y(0.60)+4}" fill="#666" font-size="9" text-anchor="end">60%</text>`;
  g+=`<line x1="${padL}" y1="${y(LABOR_TARGET)}" x2="${W-padR}" y2="${y(LABOR_TARGET)}" stroke="#5a2520" stroke-dasharray="4 4" stroke-width="1"/>`;
  g+=`<text x="${W-padR}" y="${y(LABOR_TARGET)-4}" fill="#a05047" font-size="9" text-anchor="end">${Math.round(LABOR_TARGET*100)}% target</text>`;
  let pts=LABOR_MONTHLY.map((v,i)=>[padL+gw*0.5+i*gw,y(v)]);
  g+=`<polyline fill="none" stroke="#E1251B" stroke-width="2.5" points="${pts.map(p=>p.join(',')).join(' ')}"/>`;
  pts.forEach((p,i)=>{g+=`<circle cx="${p[0]}" cy="${p[1]}" r="3.5" fill="#E1251B"/>`;
    g+=`<text x="${p[0]}" y="${p[1]-9}" fill="#ddd" font-size="9.5" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Michroma">${Math.round(LABOR_MONTHLY[i]*100)}</text>`;
    g+=`<text x="${p[0]}" y="${H-6}" fill="#888" font-size="9.5" text-anchor="middle">${MONTHS[i]}</text>`;});
  $("laborTrend").innerHTML=`<div class="pmeta" style="text-align:left;margin-bottom:4px;color:#9a9a9a">Monthly labor % trend</div><svg class="chart" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">${g}</svg>`;
}

function financePanel(){
  const over90Pct=pct(FIN.over90,(FIN.ar||0)+(FIN.retention||0));
  const trendUp=OVER90_TREND[OVER90_TREND.length-1]>OVER90_TREND[0];
  const cards=[
    ["Total Receivables",fmtM(FIN.ar+FIN.retention),`AR ${fmtM(FIN.ar)} + Retainage ${fmtM(FIN.retention)}`],
    ["AR Over 90 Days",fmtM(FIN.over90),`<span class="pill ${over90Pct>=8?'r':'a'}">${over90Pct}% of AR+Ret ${trendUp?'▲':'▼'}</span>`],
    ["Accounts Payable",fmtM(FIN.ap),""],
    ["Pending EWA Change Orders",fmtM(FIN.pco),""],
    ["Approved Change Orders YTD",fmtM(FIN.approvedCO),""],
  ];
  $("finance").innerHTML=cards.map(c=>`<div class="fincard"><div class="fl">${c[0]}</div><div class="fv">${c[1]}</div><div class="fx">${c[2]||'&nbsp;'}</div></div>`).join("");
  const topList=(title,arr)=>`<div class="topcol"><div class="th"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>${title}</div>`+(arr||[]).map((r,i)=>`<div class="toprow"><span class="rk">${i+1}</span><span class="nm">${r[0]}</span><span class="am">${fmtM(r[1])}</span></div>`).join("")+`</div>`;
  var ft=$("finTop"); if(ft) ft.innerHTML=topList("Top 5 Customers — Receivables",FIN.topCustomers)+topList("Top 5 Projects — Receivables",FIN.topProjects)+topList("Top 5 Projects Over 90",FIN.over90Projects)+topList("Top 5 Approved COs",FIN.topApprovedCO);
}

function riskPanel(){
  $("riskMeta").innerHTML=`${WATCH.jobs} jobs · <b style="color:#fff">${fmtM(WATCH.balance)}</b> at risk · ${fmtM(WATCH.pendingPco)} pending PCOs`;
  $("risk").innerHTML=WATCH.groups.map(g=>
    `<div class="wgrp">
       <div class="wghead"><span class="wr"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>${g.reason}</span>
       <span class="wm"><b>${g.count}</b> jobs · ${fmtM(g.amount)}</span></div>
       <div class="wjobs">${g.jobs.map(j=>`<span class="wjob">${j}</span>`).join("")}</div>
     </div>`).join("");
}

function hrPanel(){
  const selfPerform=(HR.field||0)+(HR.pms||0)+(HR.foremen||0);
  const totalHC=(HR.employees||0)+(HR.contractField||0);
  const items=[
    {l:"Total Headcount",v:totalHC,s:"W-2 + subs"},
    {l:"Self-Perform",v:selfPerform,s:"field + PMs + foremen"},
    {l:"Office",v:HR.office,s:"staff"},
    {l:"PMs",v:HR.pms,s:"managers"},
    {l:"Foremen",v:HR.foremen,s:"+ FIT"},
    {l:"Subcontract",v:HR.contractField,s:"field workers"},
  ];
  $("hrGauges").innerHTML=items.map(i=>
    `<div class="mini"><div class="l">${i.l}</div><div class="v">${i.v==null?'—':i.v}</div><div class="s">${i.s}</div></div>`).join("");
  const totalField=selfPerform+(HR.contractField||0), sp=pct(selfPerform,totalField);
  $("laborMix").innerHTML=
    `<div class="pmeta" style="text-align:left;margin-bottom:6px;color:#9a9a9a">Field labor mix — ${selfPerform} self-perform (field + PMs + foremen) vs ${HR.contractField} subcontract (${totalField} on the ground)</div>
     <div class="bar" style="height:14px"><i data-w="${Math.max(3,sp)}"></i></div>
     <div class="legend"><span><i class="swA"></i> Self-perform ${sp}%</span><span><i class="swB"></i> Subcontract ${100-sp}%</span></div>`;
  $("hrMeta").innerHTML=`wk ${HR.latestWeek} · ${(HR.hoursYTD/1000).toFixed(0)}K hrs YTD · OT ${pct(HR.otYTD,HR.hoursYTD)}%`;
}
function staffingPanel(){
  const cover=pct(HR.projectsWithForeman,HR.activeProjects);
  const rows=[
    ["Active projects",String(HR.activeProjects),""],
    ["With OE foreman",String(HR.projectsWithForeman),`<span class="pill ${cover>=90?'g':'a'}">${cover}%</span>`],
    ["Jobs needing foreman",String(HR.jobsNeedForeman),`<span class="pill ${HR.jobsNeedForeman>0?'a':'g'}">gap</span>`],
    ["Employees unplaced",String(HR.unplaced),`<span class="pill g">staffed</span>`],
    ["Recordable injuries — YTD",String(SAFETY.recordables),`<span class="pill ${SAFETY.fatalities||SAFETY.severe?'r':'g'}">${SAFETY.fatalities} fatal · ${SAFETY.severe} severe</span>`],
  ];
  $("staffing").innerHTML=rows.map(r=>`<div class="stat"><span class="sl">${r[0]}</span><span class="sv">${r[1]} ${r[2]}</span></div>`).join("");
}

function hoursStrip(){
  var host=$("hoursStrip"); if(!host) return;
  var T=(typeof HOURS_TREND!=="undefined")?HOURS_TREND:null;
  if(!T){ host.innerHTML=''; return; }
  const arrow=x=>x>0?'▲':(x<0?'▼':'—');
  const toneUp=x=>x>0?'up':(x<0?'down':'flat');   // rising hours = green
  var wow=T.wowPct, vsMa=T.latestVsMa4, ot=T.otPct;
  var otTone= ot==null?'':(ot>0.12?'down':(ot>0.08?'flat':'up'));
  var cards=[
    {l:'Latest Week Hours', v:fmtNum(T.latestTotal), s:'wk '+(T.latestWeek||''), cls:(wow==null?'':toneUp(wow)), ar:(wow==null?'':arrow(wow))},
    {l:'Week / Week', v:(wow==null?'—':(wow>0?'+':'')+Math.round(wow*100)+'%'), s:'vs prior week', cls:(wow==null?'':toneUp(wow)), ar:(wow==null?'':arrow(wow))},
    {l:'4-Wk Avg', v:fmtNum(T.ma4), s:(vsMa==null?'moving avg':(vsMa>=0?'latest above avg':'latest below avg')), cls:(vsMa==null?'':toneUp(vsMa)), ar:(vsMa==null?'':arrow(vsMa))},
    {l:'Overtime %', v:(ot==null?'—':Math.round(ot*100)+'%'), s:'of hours', cls:otTone, ar:''},
    {l:'Hours / Head', v:(T.hrsPerHead==null?'—':T.hrsPerHead.toFixed(1)), s:(T.emp?T.emp+' on payroll':'per employee'), cls:'', ar:''},
  ];
  host.innerHTML=cards.map(c=>
    `<div class="mini"><div class="l">${c.l}</div><div class="v ${c.cls}">${c.ar?`<span class="ar">${c.ar}</span>`:''}${c.v}</div><div class="s">${c.s}</div></div>`).join("");
}
function hoursPanel(){
  if(typeof HOURS==="undefined" || !HOURS || !(HOURS.headers||[]).length) return;
  var H=HOURS.headers, R=HOURS.rows||[];
  var thead='<thead><tr>'+H.map(function(c){return '<th>'+(c||'')+'</th>';}).join('')+'</tr></thead>';
  var tbody='<tbody>'+R.map(function(r){
    return '<tr>'+r.map(function(c){return '<td>'+(c||'')+'</td>';}).join('')+'</tr>';
  }).join('')+'</tbody>';
  $("hoursTable").innerHTML=thead+tbody;
  var m=$("hoursMeta"); if(m) m.textContent=R.length+' weeks';
}
function animateBars(){ requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
  document.querySelectorAll('.bar i').forEach(el=>{el.style.width=el.dataset.w+'%';}); })); }

function tick(){ $("time").textContent=new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US',{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'}); }

function renderAll(){
  var steps=[kpiTiles,revChart,annualPanel,bdPanel,regionPanel,costGauges,laborTrend,financePanel,riskPanel,hrPanel,staffingPanel,hoursStrip,hoursPanel];
  steps.forEach(function(fn){ try{ fn(); }catch(e){ /* skip a panel that has no data instead of blanking the page */ } });
  animateBars();
}
function boot(D){
  D=D||{};
  ASOF=D.ASOF||''; MONTHS=D.MONTHS||["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"];
  REV_PROJ=D.REV_PROJ||[]; REV_ACT=D.REV_ACT||[]; ACT_MONTHS=D.ACT_MONTHS||0; REV_TARGET_MONTHLY=D.REV_TARGET_MONTHLY||11250000;
  ANNUAL=D.ANNUAL||{}; GROSS_PROFIT=D.GROSS_PROFIT||{}; NET_PROFIT=D.NET_PROFIT||{};
  BD=D.BD||{pipeline:{regions:[]},awards:{regions:[]},bids:{regions:[]}};
  REGIONS=D.REGIONS||[]; COST=D.COST||{}; LABOR_MONTHLY=D.LABOR_MONTHLY||[]; LABOR_TARGET=D.LABOR_TARGET||0.40;
  FIN=D.FIN||{}; OVER90_TREND=D.OVER90_TREND||[]; WATCH=D.WATCH||{groups:[]}; SAFETY=D.SAFETY||{}; TRIR=D.TRIR; HR=D.HR||{};
  HOURS=D.HOURS||null;
  HOURS_TREND=D.HOURS_TREND||null;
  renderAll();
  var errs=Object.keys(D).filter(function(k){return /Err$/.test(k);});
  var a=document.getElementById("asof");
  if(a) a.textContent=(ASOF||"")+(errs.length?("  ·  \u26A0 "+errs.length+" section(s) unavailable: "+errs.map(function(k){return k.replace(/^_|Err$/g,"");}).join(", ")):"");
  tick(); setInterval(tick,15000);
}
function showErr(e){ var a=document.getElementById("asof"); if(a) a.textContent="Could not load data: "+(e&&e.message?e.message:e); }
function loadData(){
  var a=document.getElementById("asof"); if(a) a.textContent="Loading live data…";
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(boot).withFailureHandler(showErr).getData();
}
document.getElementById("refreshBtn").addEventListener("click", loadData);
loadData();
</script>
</body>
</html>
